description: What changed in the directory in the last days (default 7, at most 31): level_moves, each product's level going up or down between two of its drives, with the date, the cause in words (our agent changed, not confirmed by a second drive yet, sign-up varies from drive to drive) and the level listed now (level_now); net, each product once from its first level in the span to its last (up, down, back); confirmed, the changes the next drive confirmed (the change feed's items); and moves of where it stopped or how it gets in (listed for one product or category, else counted). Newest first. category or slug narrows it.
